mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level directly reduces equity discount rates, increasing present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window of 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) creates stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals sustained economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases in late-cycle expansion periods (UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized) do not produce positive 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% YoY indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.5% MoM) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for 60-day forward returns when RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll increase (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.3% indicates strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects sustained economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for 60-day forward returns when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized.
